mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Relating to final emancipation, leading to it, effecting it, &c.
E.
निःश्रेयस, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to final emancipation, &c.
E.
निःश्रेयस, and ठक् aff.

n. (-ह्यं)
1 Dryness, austerity.
2 Coldness, want of feeling or affection.
E.
निःस्नेह, and ष्यञ् aff.
